grid.expression: SELECT CASE WHEN T.ENTSAI = 'E' THEN 'ENTRADAS' ELSE 'SAIDAS' END AS MOVIMENTO, T.UF, T.ENTSAI, SUM(T.BASEST) AS BASEST, SUM(T.ICMSST) AS VLRICMSST, SUM(T.DIFALDEST) AS DIFALDEST, SUM(T.ICMSCFP) AS ICMSFCP, SUM(T.FCPDIFALDEST) AS FCPDIFALDEST, SUM(T.FCPST) AS FCPST, SUM(T.STGNRE) AS STGNRE, SUM(T.STGNREABERTO) AS STGNREABERTO, SUM(T.STGNREPAGO) AS STGNREPAGO, SUM(T.DIFALFCPGRNE) AS DIFALFCPGRNE, SUM(T.DIFALFCPGRNEABERTO) AS DIFALFCPGRNEABERTO, SUM(T.DIFALFCPGRNEPAGO) AS DIFALFCPGRNEPAGO FROM (SELECT UFS.UF, LIV.ENTSAI, LIV.CODCFO, LIV.NUNOTA, LIV.NUMNOTA, SUM(LIV.BASERETENCAO) AS BASEST, SUM(LIV.ICMSRETENCAO) AS ICMSST, CASE WHEN LIV.ENTSAI = 'E' THEN SUM(LIV.VLRICMSDIFALREM) ELSE SUM(LIV.VLRICMSDIFALDEST) END AS DIFALDEST, SUM(LIV.VLRICMSFCPINT) AS ICMSCFP, SUM(LIV.VLRICMSFCP) AS FCPDIFALDEST, SUM(LIV.VLRSTFCPINT) AS FCPST, CASE PAR.CLASSIFICMS WHEN 'C' THEN 'Consumidor Final' WHEN 'I' THEN 'Isento de ICMS' WHEN 'P' THEN 'Produtor Rural' WHEN 'R' THEN 'Revendedor' WHEN 'X' THEN 'Consumidor Final Contribuinte' END AS CLASSIFICACAO, CAST(PAR.CODPARC AS VARCHAR) + ' - ' + PAR.RAZAOSOCIAL AS PARCEIRO, (SELECT ISNULL(SUM(FIN.VLRDESDOB), 0) FROM TGFFIN FIN WHERE FIN.NUNOTA = LIV.NUNOTA AND FIN.CODNAT = 1010202) AS STGNRE, (SELECT ISNULL(SUM(FIN.VLRDESDOB), 0) FROM TGFFIN FIN WHERE FIN.NUNOTA = LIV.NUNOTA AND FIN.CODNAT = 1010202 AND FIN.DHBAIXA IS NULL) AS STGNREABERTO, (SELECT ISNULL(SUM(FIN.VLRDESDOB), 0) FROM TGFFIN FIN WHERE FIN.NUNOTA = LIV.NUNOTA AND FIN.CODNAT = 1010202 AND FIN.DHBAIXA IS NOT NULL) AS STGNREPAGO, (SELECT ISNULL(SUM(FIN.VLRDESDOB), 0) FROM TGFFIN FIN WHERE FIN.NUNOTA = LIV.NUNOTA AND FIN.CODNAT = 1010602) AS DIFALFCPGRNE, (SELECT ISNULL(SUM(FIN.VLRDESDOB), 0) FROM TGFFIN FIN WHERE FIN.NUNOTA = LIV.NUNOTA AND FIN.CODNAT = 1010602 AND FIN.DHBAIXA IS NULL) AS DIFALFCPGRNEABERTO, (SELECT ISNULL(SUM(FIN.VLRDESDOB), 0) FROM TGFFIN FIN WHERE FIN.NUNOTA = LIV.NUNOTA AND FIN.CODNAT = 1010602 AND FIN.DHBAIXA IS NOT NULL) AS DIFALFCPGRNEPAGO FROM TGFLIV LIV INNER JOIN TGFCAB CAB ON CAB.NUNOTA = LIV.NUNOTA INNER JOIN TGFITE ITE ON ITE.NUNOTA = CAB.NUNOTA AND ITE.NUNOTA = LIV.NUNOTA AND ITE.SEQUENCIA = LIV.SEQUENCIA INNER JOIN TGFPRO PRO ON PRO.CODPROD = ITE.CODPROD INNER JOIN TGFPAR PAR ON PAR.CODPARC = CAB.CODPARC AND PAR.CODPARC = LIV.CODPARC INNER JOIN TSICID CID ON CID.CODCID = PAR.CODCID INNER JOIN TSIUFS UFS ON UFS.CODUF = CID.UF LEFT JOIN TGFPEM PEM ON PEM.CODEMP = LIV.CODEMP AND PEM.CODPROD = ITE.CODPROD LEFT JOIN TGFDIN DINP ON DINP.NUNOTA = CAB.NUNOTA AND DINP.NUNOTA = ITE.NUNOTA AND DINP.SEQUENCIA = ITE.SEQUENCIA AND DINP.NUNOTA = LIV.NUNOTA AND DINP.SEQUENCIA = LIV.SEQUENCIA AND DINP.CODIMP = 6 LEFT JOIN TGFDIN DINC ON DINC.NUNOTA = CAB.NUNOTA AND DINC.NUNOTA = ITE.NUNOTA AND DINC.SEQUENCIA = ITE.SEQUENCIA AND DINC.NUNOTA = LIV.NUNOTA AND DINC.SEQUENCIA = LIV.SEQUENCIA AND DINC.CODIMP = 7 LEFT JOIN TGFDIN DINI ON DINI.NUNOTA = CAB.NUNOTA AND DINI.NUNOTA = ITE.NUNOTA AND DINI.SEQUENCIA = ITE.SEQUENCIA AND DINI.NUNOTA = LIV.NUNOTA AND DINI.SEQUENCIA = LIV.SEQUENCIA AND DINI.CODIMP = 1 WHERE LIV.CODEMP = :CODEMP AND LIV.DHMOV BETWEEN :PERIODO.INI AND PAR.CODPARC = LIV.CODPARC INNER JOIN TSICID CID ON CID.CODCID = PAR.CODCID INNER JOIN TSIUFS UFS ON UFS.CODUF = CID.UF LEFT JOIN TGFPEM PEM ON PEM.CODEMP = LIV.CODEMP AND PEM.CODPROD = ITE.CODPROD LEFT JOIN TGFDIN DINP ON DINP.NUNOTA = CAB.NUNOTA AND DINP.NUNOTA = ITE.NUNOTA AND DINP.SEQUENCIA = ITE.SEQUENCIA AND DINP.NUNOTA = LIV.NUNOTA AND DINP.SEQUENCIA = LIV.SEQUENCIA AND DINP.CODIMP = 6 LEFT JOIN TGFDIN DINC ON DINC.NUNOTA = CAB.NUNOTA AND DINC.NUNOTA = ITE.NUNOTA AND DINC.SEQUENCIA = ITE.SEQUENCIA AND DINC.NUNOTA = LIV.NUNOTA AND DINC.SEQUENCIA = LIV.SEQUENCIA AND DINC.CODIMP = 7 LEFT JOIN TGFDIN DINI ON DINI.NUNOTA = CAB.NUNOTA AND DINI.NUNOTA = ITE.NUNOTA AND DINI.SEQUENCIA = ITE.SEQUENCIA AND DINI.NUNOTA = LIV.NUNOTA AND DINI.SEQUENCIA = LIV.SEQUENCIA AND DINI.CODIMP = 1 WHERE LIV.CODEMP = :CODEMP AND LIV.DHMOV BETWEEN :PERIODO.INI AND :PERIODO.FIN AND LIV.ENTSAI = 'S' GROUP BY UFS.UF, LIV.ENTSAI, LIV.CODCFO, LIV.NUNOTA, LIV.NUMNOTA, PAR.CLASSIFICMS, PAR.CODPARC, PAR.RAZAOSOCIAL) T GROUP BY T.ENTSAI, T.UF, T.ENTSAI ORDER BY 1, 2
